resources.string: Indonesian news without ads or \"Baca Juga\" interruptions, every page merged into one. Your browser stays your browser; only news links open clean.

Tap the button below → \"Add link\" → tick all the news sites → Add.
The first time you open a news link, your phone asks which app to use. Pick Sapu Berita, then \"Always\".
Everything runs on your phone. Sapu Berita has no server and doesn\'t know what you read.
